headline: Spot Gold Steadies at $3,722 Near 14-Month Low as Fed Hike Bets Press
summary: Spot gold held steady at $3,722.84 per ounce after falling to a 14-month low of $3,693.13. Expectations of potential US Federal Reserve interest rate hikes and a firm US dollar continue to weigh on non-yielding metals.
why: Gold is a non-yielding global reserve asset whose price responds inversely to US real interest rates and dollar strength.

impacts.name: Gold
impacts.why: Persistent monetary tightening bets capped upside momentum for non-yielding bullion.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Expectations of prolonged high US interest rates maintained pressure on bullion prices.
